_note: PLACEHOLDER. This file fixes the catalogue FORMAT the randomizer reads; every text in it is filler. The persona catalogue task (Notion, Sep 17) writes prompts/personas/catalogue.json with the real backstories, anchor sets and control prompts and bumps `version`. Slots available in template.persona and template.reminder: {name} {backstory} {anchors} {anchor_1}..{anchor_n} {openness_text} {openness_reminder} {reminder_self} {opening} {topic} {topic_phrase} {ideology} {role}. The bare control is the setting line and opening request only, so control.persona is normally just {opening}; control.persona and control.reminder may use {opening} {topic} {topic_phrase}.
